build_ci_validate_cache_offline: build a call to ci_validate_cache_and_enable_offline_if_complete to validate snapshot completeness and enable offline mode
test_ci_validate_and_cleanup_snapshot: test ci_validate_and_cleanup_local_snapshot to validate a local model snapshot and auto-cleanup corrupted files
run_ci_download_with_retry: run ci_download_with_validation_and_retry to download model weights with automatic corruption detection and retry
review_validate_cache_detailed_reason: review validate_cache_with_detailed_reason to validate cache and get a detailed failure reason string
run_ci_clean_hf_cache: run ci_validate_and_clean_hf_cache to scan and remove corrupted safetensors files from the HF cache
